attributes.description:
Join The Q 99.7 for A Night of Worship with Josh Baldwin at Cornerstone Church—an unforgettable evening of inspiring music, heartfelt worship, and a message of hope.

Known for songs like "Stand in Your Love," "Evidence," "Made for More," and "There Is Freedom," Josh Baldwin has encouraged believers around the world through authentic worship and powerful songwriting.

Josh will be joined by special guest Patrick Mayberry, who will perform hit songs "Holy Spirit Come" & "Lead on Good Shephard."

Don't miss this special evening at Cornerstone Church in East Longmeadow on Saturday, November 8th!

Tickets are required to attend this event. Click the link below to get your tickets now!

https://events.humanitix.com/a-night-of-worship-with-josh-baldwin?h=bemzjfbT6mTHRwRsnCP45zmZnb_yKxdsSA2YBAlFAUs&t=1783629024607
